activities.name: Finalize drilling program and well plan
Permit to drill approved
activities.notes: The state approval date is outside the crew's control, so it is held with a finish no earlier than constraint.

activities.name: Pre-spud meeting with rig and service crews
Order casing, wellhead and float equipment
Casing and wellhead delivery (vendor lead time)
Move rig loads to new pad
Drill 17-1/2 in surface hole to 1,800 ft
Nipple up BOP and pressure test
Drill 12-1/4 in intermediate hole to 7,500 ft
Test casing and drill out shoe track
Drill 8-3/4 in lateral to total depth
Circulate and condition hole at TD
Trip out for open hole logs
Log review and casing point sign-off
Nipple down BOP and set slips
Rig down for move to next pad
Well handed to completions
activities.notes: Completions crew is booked from this date.

Move rig loads to new pad
Drill 17-1/2 in surface hole to 1,800 ft
Nipple up BOP and pressure test

Drill 8-3/4 in lateral to total depth
Circulate and condition hole at TD

Nipple down BOP and set slips

Well handed to completions

Well handed to completions
